fields.YouTube title: PARAM Rudra: India Is Building Its Own Supercomputing Ecosystem
fields.YouTube description (includes hashtags):
India is building domestic expertise in supercomputing through the National Supercomputing Mission and C-DAC’s Rudra servers.

As of September 2026, the government reported 6,000 Rudra servers deployed and another 1,500 under manufacturing. Across the National Supercomputing Mission, 40 supercomputers had a combined capacity of 68 petaflops — roughly 74% above the 39 petaflops reported in December 2025.

These systems support research in weather forecasting, medicine, materials science and more. Domestic server design and manufacturing do not mean all processors are indigenous; the systems also use processors from international chipmakers.
